text:
maria_sales: Quick Q from Acme POC — sec wants data processed in APAC only. Can we pin a tenant to ap-southeast-1 for the hosted API? If APAC capacity is full, what's fallback behavior? Also need APAC subprocessor list for the security questionnaire and whether failover to EU triggers cross-region egress billing.

owen_prod: For Hosted API we offer region affinity but it's best-effort. Tenant pinning (hard guarantee) is available on Dedicated/Private. Hosted routing policy: try ap-southeast-1 -> ap-northeast-1 -> eu-west-1. If no capacity, request will fail over per policy; we can set a strict no-failover route for the POC if requested (may increase lat/err rates).

tara_eng_infra: TL;DR: hosted = affinity; dedicated/private = pin. Fallback behavior: default = failover to nearest healthy region. If you want to force ap-southeast-1 only, use Dedicated or Private and set `routing.strict = true`.

maria_sales: Is there a short wording I can paste into the SecQ? They want a 1-2 sentence statement they can put in the questionnaire.

tara_eng_infra: Suggested: "Redwood routes requests to the customer's preferred region (e.g., ap-southeast-1). Hosted API uses affinity but may fail over under capacity; Dedicated/Private deployments support tenant pinning to prevent cross-region processing." :thumbsup:

kevin_sales_eng: Also need list of subprocessors for APAC (GCP cloud, CDN, monitoring). Can we attach an exportable CSV?

owen_prod: APAC subprocessors (short): - Google Cloud Platform (ap-southeast-1) - Cloud CDN via FastEdge/Telstra - SRE monitoring: LogFlow Asia (subproc) - KMS: Customer-managed BYOK via CloudKMS (if opted). I'll ping legal to attach formal attestation doc.

legalbot: @maria_sales I uploaded the APAC subprocessor attestation to the deal folder: https://redwood.internal/docs/acme/poc-subprocs (attestation v2026-03-22).

maria_sales: Awesome — last: billing impact. If they fallback to EU, will they be charged egress for cross-region? Customer asked specifically.

tara_eng_infra: Yes — cross-region egress applies for Hosted fallback. For the POC we can grant a one-time 100GB egress credit; ops will track. If you need no egress billing, Dedicated with pinning avoids cross-region egress.

kevin_sales_eng: Noted. I'll add that to the quote (100GB credit for POC). Thanks all.

maria_sales: Cool, closing loop with customer, will paste the suggested wording and attach subproc link. Thanks! :raised_hands: 

deploy-bot: reminder: created ticket #POC-412 for ops to apply 100GB egress credit to Acme trial.
